name: MADAR email alert — SMTP setup required

parameters.content:
# Optional email delivery — NOT OPERATIONAL
Authorized recipient configured. SMTP sender/credential missing. Keep inactive. Select a real SMTP credential in the Send email node and set fromEmail in Declared email configuration. Run Manual delivery test and confirm receipt independently. Only then link this as the monitoring error workflow. No alert delivery or activation has been verified. No automatic retry: response-loss after SMTP acceptance can duplicate mail.
